projections.note: POOLED is delivered only by the pooled edition '2016 - 2018' under the listed version label, so its one pooled state binds a over the whole pooled range. MIXED's explicit 2017 cuts the same pooled range: the pooled 2016 and 2018 and the explicit 2017 each bind a.

The only issues are MIXED's code 3, which a lacks, once per bound state. Each cites the evidence of its own span: the pooled years cite the pooled edition 1618, the explicit 2017 only its own edition, never the pooled edition it overrides (an acknowledgement pins an issue's refs, so a pooled ref here would stale annual acknowledgements).
